title: Northgate Marketplace Guarantee Coverage and Filing Terms
content:
**Guarantee coverage.** The Northgate Marketplace Guarantee of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee covers the claim reasons listed for each seller program and is filed under the waiting periods, windows and frequency figures below. The six seller programs of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee are Northgate Marketplace Seller-Fulfilled, Northgate Marketplace Pro Seller, Northgate Marketplace Fulfilled by Northgate, Northgate Marketplace Freight Seller, Northgate Marketplace Certified Renewed and Northgate Marketplace International Seller; the columns below carry their names without the Northgate Marketplace prefix.

| Term | Seller-Fulfilled | Pro Seller | Fulfilled by Northgate | Freight Seller | Certified Renewed | International Seller |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claim reasons the guarantee covers | not received, not as described, return not refunded, seller unresponsive | not received, not as described, return not refunded, seller unresponsive | not received, not as described, return not refunded | not received, not as described, return not refunded, seller unresponsive | not received, not as described, return not refunded, seller unresponsive, renewed defect | not received, not as described, return not refunded, seller unresponsive |
| A change of mind is covered by the guarantee | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Business days the buyer must give the seller to respond after contacting them before a guarantee claim can be filed; 0 where Northgate is the seller-side contact | 2 | 2 | 0 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Calendar days after the maximum estimated delivery date after which a not-received claim can be filed | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 7 |
| Calendar days after the maximum estimated delivery date within which a guarantee claim must be filed | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Guarantee claims a buyer may file in any rolling 12 months before further claims go to specialist review | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| A claim is closed when the buyer has a card dispute open or resolved on the same charge | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Calendar days after delivery during which a renewed item that stops working is covered as a renewed defect; 0 where not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 90 | 0 |
| Minimum seller warranty on renewed items in months; 0 where not applicable | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 | 0 |
| Channels in which a guarantee claim can be filed | online, phone | online, phone | online, phone | online, phone | online, phone | online, phone |

**Points of reading.**

- Seller unresponsive is not a covered reason under Fulfilled by Northgate, where Northgate is the seller-side contact; renewed defect is covered only under Certified Renewed, for 90 calendar days after delivery, with a seller warranty of at least 12 months.
- The not-received waiting period is 3 calendar days on every program except International Seller, where it is 7; the claim window is 90 calendar days on all six programs.
- The frequency figure is 4 claims in any rolling 12 months on every program.
